likely_causes: Blown main fuse or poor battery terminal connection
Hybrid control module fault after prolonged discharge
safety_notes: Ventilate when jump-starting; sparks near battery can ignite hydrogen
Do not reverse polarity on hybrid vehicles
If jump-start does not work, avoid repeated cranking — seek diagnosis
Clean terminals with proper tools; wear eye protection
Keep a spare mechanical key accessible
Replace bulbs in pairs when practical
Never open radiator cap when engine is hot
